context.narrative_job: Test one net-new EP007 Short that gives a cold viewer a complete owner-dependency exercise, establishes the Operator Economy channel promise and only then opens the larger fixed-fee-business question through Related Video.
context.viewer_before: Prior EP007 Short attempts related to the episode but behaved like repurposed episode material or trailers whose useful answer depended on the click.
context.viewer_after: The viewer meets Manav and the thirty-day constraint immediately, circles owner-held answers, applies all three handoff questions to every circle, receives a bounded first working map and then sees the larger commercial test.

data.choice: Prototype Short 01 as a 38-second avatar-led portrait animatic: open on THIRTY DAYS. NO OWNER.; turn three illustrative owner statements into a clearly labeled first working map; identify the recurring channel path as THE OPERATOR ECONOMY to BUSINESS UNDER TEST to THE WORK; settle the claim boundary; then expose the Related Video question. Use the accepted V5 identity only as a labeled non-speaking hold with scratch voice.
data.reason: This structure lets the Short close its own narrow promise while creating a distinct reason to continue. The explicit ASK ALL 3 hub prevents the working method from being misread, and the channel name prevents the series labels from reading as internal production language.

alternatives.choice: Cut a vertical excerpt from R79.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: It would preserve episode performance but would not create a net-new standalone story or channel discovery path.

alternatives.choice: End on the Related Video prompt before completing the map.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: That would make the episode click responsible for the Short's first useful answer.

alternatives.choice: Reuse accepted V5 speaking footage under the new script.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The mouth performance and narration do not match; freezing, looping or retiming a speaking face would create a false performance.

alternatives.choice: Buy a new avatar take during the structure test.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Exact copy and owner structural approval remain pending, so provider spend is premature.

reuse.applies_when: Reviewing this one EP007 Short structure before exact-copy and avatar-performance lock.
reuse.avoid_when: Treating its exact length, hook, labels or visual mechanism as a locked template for the remaining Shorts or another episode.

animation.form: Avatar-led direct address with one paper-based causal mechanism.
animation.entry: Manav and the constraint share frame zero; no logo or episode pre-roll delays the hook.
animation.change: Oxide circles the repeated owner I; steel carries every circled dependency through ASK ALL 3 to the three handoff questions.
animation.hold: FIRST WORKING MAP settles beside the avatar and the diagnostic limit before any continuation cue.
animation.exit: The Related Video question appears after the payoff, with the target explicitly pending.

nuance.performance: Static V5 identity and local scratch voice test only structure, rhythm and phone comprehension. They do not test final delivery, lip sync, gesture or stochastic avatar quality.
nuance.false_inference: The exercise exposes owner-held relationships, decisions and records without handoffs. It does not predict business failure, valuation, sale outcome or buyer behavior.
nuance.source_basis: Owner request to test the discovery-and-distribution structure on one Short, the current EP007 companion decision chain, Content OS spoken-copy boundaries and Boundary Ledger portrait direction.

data.approval_boundary: This event records an internally verified prototype ready for owner structural review. It does not record owner acceptance, exact-copy lock, claim clearance, provider authority, final narration, generated performance, render, release or publication. R79 remains untouched.
